scope: Exact business API path/method admission before authentication queries or resource dispatch
before: The regression issued DELETE to a synthetic KTP's preview subresource; the old runtime removed the material and its following canonical GET returned 404

implementation.catalog: One exact route/method catalog, literal-route precedence and no prefix matching
implementation.rejection: Unknown or extended path returns 404; unsupported method returns 405 with path-specific Allow including OPTIONS
implementation.options: Explicit Next.js OPTIONS and PUT exports prevent framework-wide generated method metadata from bypassing the business contract; OPTIONS returns an empty 204 response
implementation.access: OPTIONS describes a route pattern only, without looking up a private resource. Known data operations retain authentication, ownership, CSRF, request bounds, read/write budgets and teacher-review checks
implementation.gateway: Netlify signature validation still precedes business-route admission; health/auth remain separate

verification.contract: Original malformed deletion now returns 405 and leaves the exact saved KTP unchanged; unsupported account/profile/task/collection/job/draft operations reject before mutation
verification.state: Saved plan, approved generation and profile unchanged after the invalid-method/path matrix
verification.normalBehavior: Canonical editing and deletion, owner/CSRF rejection, password/session rotation, bounded chunked JSON, uploads, exports, quarantine, read-budget recovery and source checks passed
verification.optionalOtp: One real-Mailpit registration case passed with verification temporarily enabled
verification.noSmtp: Both main and Lite registration cases passed with verification disabled and SMTP absent; normal local runtime restored afterward
verification.build: Production Docker web build, lint, typecheck, source visibility, diff checks and recognizable-secret scan passed

ciChange.primary: Ordinary business scenarios use the owner's selected mail-free signup mode; only the explicit OTP test is excluded from this phase
ciChange.dedicatedOtp: Restart the same built web with verification enabled and require that OTP scenario to pass
ciChange.noSmtp: Then restart with verification disabled and SMTP absent for dedicated no-mail signup tests
ciChange.reason: Installed auth code limits OTP verification to three requests per minute per IP/path. Requiring OTP for every fixture unnecessarily throttles the whole suite
ciChange.performanceClaim: No numerical CI duration reduction is claimed before a complete remote run

remaining: The complete latest GitHub CI and real Netlify/Railway ingress behavior are separate gates
This exact dispatcher boundary is not a global ingress or memory limit
Large resource handlers still need gradual separation into typed services without weakening these invariants
